## Summary

**The Needle Found:** The bug is in `src/codegen.rs` at line 75.

**Current (Buggy) Code:**
```rust
"    pub fn {}(&self) -> {} {{\n        &self.{}\n    }}\n\n",
```

**Should Be (Fixed):**
```rust
"    pub fn {}(&self) -> &{} {{\n        &self.{}\n    }}\n\n",
```

**The Fix:** Add an ampersand (`&`) before `{}` in the return type to change it from returning an owned value to returning a reference.

This change will make the generated getters return references (`&Company`, `&Address`) instead of owned values (`Company`, `Address`), which matches the test expectations in `test.sh` and fixes the code generation bug.

The test script `test.sh` will pass once this single character change is made, as it specifically checks for the correct reference-based return types in the generated code.
